quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #19
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: You see a green traffic light, but traffic is blocking the intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Partially enter the intersection to claim your right-of-way.
Do not enter the intersection unless you can drive all the way across.
Drive into the intersection and wait for traffic to clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter the intersection unless you can drive all the way across.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, only enter the intersection if you can drive completely through before the light turns red. Blocking the intersection can result in a ticket.

questions.question: What does alcohol affect first?

options.text: Vision.
Judgment.
Balance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Judgment.
questions.explanation: Alcohol harms all the skills you need to drive safely. It travels from your stomach to your blood, then to the rest of your body. Alcohol damages the parts of your brain that control judgment and skill.

questions.question: How can you help prevent skidding on slippery surfaces?

options.text: Shift to a lower gear after starting down a steep hill.
Speed up before curves and slow down as you exit them.
Slow down before you enter curves and intersections.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter curves and intersections.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve because you cannot see what is ahead. Braking while turning can cause you to skid.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines between traffic lanes mean?

options.text: You can pass from the left.
You can pass from the right.
You cannot pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot pass from either direction.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Double solid lines mean no passing is allowed from either side.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow line next to a broken yellow line mean?

options.text: Vehicles in both directions may pass.
Vehicles next to the broken line may pass.
Vehicles next to the solid line may pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Vehicles next to the broken line may pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line on your side means you can pass.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must stop completely at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at a point where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A flagger is ahead.
Turn left at the intersection.
This is the last turn before a toll road.

questions.correctAnswerText: A flagger is ahead.
questions.explanation: Orange is used for work zone signs. Orange signs, cones, or barrels mean stay alert for changing driving conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead and you must follow their directions.

questions.question: You want to turn right at a corner. A person with a guide dog is waiting to cross in front of you. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off your engine until the person crosses.
Tell the pedestrian when to cross the street.
Wait until the person crosses the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the person crosses the street.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians with guide dogs or white canes must always be given the right-of-way.

questions.question: What is an important step when turning?

options.text: Check traffic in all directions.
Speed up.
Always move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check traffic in all directions.
questions.explanation: Before turning, look behind and to both sides of your vehicle to make sure it is safe. Adjust your speed to safely complete the turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
No left turn.
Merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What is a crosswalk?

options.text: Another name for a four-way intersection.
An area marked for road construction workers.
The area where pedestrians cross the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The area where pedestrians cross the road.
questions.explanation: Crosswalks are marked with white lines to show where pedestrians should cross. Some crosswalks have extra lines between or instead of the main white lines. Some crosswalks have no markings at all.

questions.question: To avoid losing traction on wet roads, you should:

options.text: Make sharp turns.
Press the brakes hard.
Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: To prevent your car from sliding on wet roads, drive slower and keep your tires in good condition. If your car starts to slide, take your foot off the gas pedal. Do not use the brakes. Keep the vehicle straight and let it slow down naturally.

questions.question: Double solid yellow lane markings mean:

options.text: No vehicle may pass.
Both vehicles may pass.
The right lane may pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: No vehicle may pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow markings separate lanes where traffic moves in opposite directions. Double solid yellow lines mean passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.question: If you are driving on a highway next to a single broken white line:

options.text: You cannot cross the line to pass.
You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
You may only cross the line to change lanes if you are in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes where traffic moves in the same direction. A broken white line means you can cross it to pass or change lanes if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Two-way traffic.
Change in direction ahead.
School zone and crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that they are leaving a divided highway and entering a road where traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: "No zones" are areas around trucks where cars:

options.text: Cannot be seen by the truck driver or are so close that the truck driver cannot stop or turn safely.
Have enough space to travel safely behind the truck.
Have several car lengths between them and the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cannot be seen by the truck driver or are so close that the truck driver cannot stop or turn safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are blind spots around trucks or buses where cars disappear from view. Cars in these areas are also too close for the truck or bus driver to stop or turn safely. Being in a "No zone" greatly increases the risk of a crash.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Intersection ahead.
Merging traffic.
Steep hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid accidents and brake problems.

questions.question: What is the purpose of rumble strips?

options.text: They warn drivers about tire problems.
They test a vehicle's shock absorbers.
They make noise and vibrations to alert drowsy drivers that their vehicle is leaving the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: They make noise and vibrations to alert drowsy drivers that their vehicle is leaving the road.
questions.explanation: Rumble strips create noise and vibrations to warn tired or inattentive drivers that they are drifting off the road or approaching a stop sign or traffic light.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: All traffic must turn right.
All traffic must go straight.
A side road intersects ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A side road intersects ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a side road is intersecting ahead.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.
For any reason.

questions.correctAnswerText: For any reason.
questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign means you must follow the rule shown. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles for any reason while the sign is in effect.

questions.question: What should you do if an oncoming driver does not dim their headlights?

options.text: Look toward the center of the road.
Look toward the right side of the road.
Look straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This prevents you from being blinded by their headlights and helps you see enough of the road to stay safe. Do not try to retaliate by keeping your bright lights on.

questions.question: How should drivers check their blind spot when changing lanes?

options.text: Check only the left outside mirror.
Look over your left or right shoulder.
Check only the inside rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your left or right shoulder.
questions.explanation: Your blind spots are areas you cannot see in your mirrors. Look over the correct shoulder to check your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.question: What does this pennant-shaped sign mean?

options.text: No passing zone.
Right turn permitted on red.
Yield right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zone.
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the beginning of a no passing zone.

questions.question: When must you use your low beam headlights?

options.text: On a lighted street.
On a freeway.
In fog.

questions.correctAnswerText: In fog.
questions.explanation: Use low beams when driving in fog, snow, rain, or mist. High beams reflect off precipitation and create glare, making it harder to see. Some vehicles have fog lights that should be used with low beams.

questions.question: Which statement about driving speed is true?

options.text: Higher speeds increase the chance of death in a crash.
Higher speeds mean you need a longer following distance.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: Higher speeds increase the risk of death in a crash. Above 80 mph, survival is almost impossible. Your stopping distance increases with speed, so you must increase your following distance when you drive faster.

questions.question: A large truck ahead is turning right onto a street with two lanes in each direction. The truck:

options.text: May complete its turn in either of the two lanes.
May have to swing wide to complete the right turn.
Must stay in the right lane at all times while turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: May have to swing wide to complete the right turn.
questions.explanation: The rear wheels of a turning vehicle follow a shorter path than the front wheels. Long trucks need extra space to turn. They often swing wide to the left to complete a right turn.

questions.question: What does this warning sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
The road narrows ahead.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards immediately ahead. This sign warns drivers of an upcoming winding road with curves.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should never:

options.text: Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot.
Change lanes suddenly without warning.
Check for other vehicles moving into the same lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes suddenly without warning.
questions.explanation: When changing lanes, make sure no vehicles are in your way. Check your mirrors and blind spots. Always use your turn signal before changing lanes to give other drivers time to react.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; curving road ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What should you do if bad weather makes it hard to see?

options.text: Speed up to get off the road quickly.
Drive in the lane closest to oncoming traffic.
Increase your following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase your following distance.
questions.explanation: When it is hard to see due to darkness or bad weather, increase your following distance. This gives you more time to react to hazards you may not see in advance.
